label: 雨夜街道 → 晴天同街角
setup: On a dark, rain-soaked city street at night, Character A stands trembling under a flickering neon sign, holding Character B's folded umbrella in both hands.
onAFace: Rain runs down their cheeks together with their tears.
bWaiting: Across the street, Character B — zombified, pale, stiff, but still unmistakably {loved} — stands perfectly still in the rain, facing Character A, watching.
atmosphere: Neon reflections shimmer on the wet asphalt. Cold blue-violet lighting and deep shadows create a tragic, oppressive atmosphere.
propLowered: Cut back to Character A, still crying, the umbrella lowered.
choice: Instead of backing away, Character A opens the umbrella and holds it out toward Character B — not in aggression, but in silent grief and recognition.
sees: Character B sees the umbrella held out to {object}.
motionless: For a brief instant, Character A remains motionless with the umbrella held open.
worldShift: The rainy night street becomes the exact same street corner on a bright, sunny afternoon.
warmLight: Golden afternoon sunlight illuminates their hair and faces. A gentle breeze moves through the street.
reveal: The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the peaceful street corner, ending on the two characters embracing under the warm sun.
soundFirst: First scene: rain on asphalt, distant city hum, shaky breathing, quiet sobbing, and rising cinematic tension.
